subject: Sprintboard: Capacity risk triage for Acme close window
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@acme.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sprintboard: Capacity risk triage for Acme close window
Attachments: sprintboard_template.xlsx (stub)

Hi team —

Quick thread to triage capacity risk for the Acme opportunity (ACM-2025-391). Elena sent a preliminary purchase forecast this morning and the close probability looks elevated for late July / early Aug. Before the deal goes to legal/procurement we need to confirm Dedicated capacity coverage and a contingency plan if they exercise burst.

Please review the attached forecast (ACME_forecast_Q3.xlsx will arrive from Elena) and reply with the following by EOD tomorrow:
- Ben / Infra: what minimum committed slots we need to guarantee SLA for a 6-month term (sustained and burst).
- Finance: any gating concerns on committing reserve inventory vs. offering burst credits.
- Sales / AE (Laura): confirm timing for signature and procurement lead time.

Proposed quick sync: Wed Jul 16 9:00am PT (30m) — please indicate if that works.

Goal: produce an agreed coverage buffer and a fallback (model variant or regional fallback) we can promise in the SOW.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Head of Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Rossi <elena@acme.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sprintboard: Capacity risk triage for Acme close window
Attachments: ACME_forecast_Q3.xlsx (stub)

Jordan — thanks for the heads up. Attaching the more detailed forecast (Q3 demand by model/peak token throughput). Key items from our side: 
- Probability: 85% to sign LOI this month; procurement aims to finalize SOW before 2025-07-22.
- Expected initial committed throughput: equivalent to roughly 12 dedicated slots (p95 usage) for the first 6 months, with potential burst up to +40% for onboarding weeks.
- Data residency: must remain in us-west for regulatory checks.

Procurement is open to a 6-month initial term with explicit burst credit clauses. I'll loop in procurement contact for signature cadence.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Director, AI Integrations
Acme Labs

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sprintboard: Capacity risk triage for Acme close window

Thanks Elena — the numbers are clear and higher than the baseline we had modeled. Quick reactions:
- Sustained commit: to meet p95 SLA with headroom, we should plan for 12 dedicated vslots as Elena suggests. That maps to ~3 x A100-equivalent hosts in us-west.
- Burst: +40% is material. We have two mitigations: 1) pre-purchase a modest burst credit pool (recommended) or 2) configure region fallback + model-quantization variant to reduce token cost during onboarding spikes.
- Ops ask: can we get a 48h lead time for warmup (KV cache priming) once procurement confirms? If not, we need to guarantee interim best-effort warm start by redirecting some traffic to shared pools.

Action requested from Infra (Kimberly / Marcus): confirm whether we can reserve 3 hosts and a 40% burst credit budget in the timeline below, and estimate incremental cost.

-Ben
Principal, Product Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena@acme.ai>, procurement@acme.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sprintboard: Capacity risk triage for Acme close window

Confirming timeline from Sales: Acme expects SOW signed by 2025-07-22, onboarding start targeted 7/28. Deal economics: ACV proposed aligns to 6-month reserved term + burst credits.

Request from AE: please size a 20% coverage buffer above Ben's recommended commit (so target 14 vslots) — this gives us breathing room for onboarding and mitigates infra scaling risk. Procurement will ask for a firm SLA and fallback in the SOW.

I'll coordinate with legal to draft an SOW template that includes: committed slots, burst credits, warmup lead time, and a regional fallback clause.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena@acme.ai>, procurement@acme.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sprintboard: Capacity risk triage for Acme close window
Attachments: sprintboard_snapshot.pdf (stub), docuSign_acme_commit_link.txt (stub)

Recap and action items (for the sync and SOW draft):
1) Capacity target: agree to 14 vslots (12 baseline + 20% buffer) in us-west for 6 months.
2) Burst plan: pre-allocate a 40% burst credit budget; Ben/Finance to provide incremental cost and pricing language.
3) Warmup: Infra to confirm 48h warmup SLA for KV priming; if not possible, document best-effort fallback to shared pools.
4) Legal/Sales: SOW to include regional residency (us-west), committed slots, burst credit clause, and DocuSign envelope will be prepared.

Meeting: let's hold a 30m call Wed Jul 16 9:00am PT to finalize numbers. Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1sprintboard_snapshot (sprintboard snapshot), DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/0ABC123

I'll own the SOW checklist; Laura will own procurement cadence; Ben will own cost estimate; Kimberly/Marcus will confirm infra reservation.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Head of Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sprintboard: Capacity risk triage for Acme close window

Ack — we can provision the 3 hosts (14 vslot target) in us-west for a 6-month period pending formal sign-off.
- Estimated infra incremental cost for the burst pool: will send numbers by EOD tomorrow.
- Warmup: 48h full KV priming is feasible with current automation if procurement signs within the proposed window; otherwise fallback to best-effort shared-pool warm start.

I'll update the sprintboard snapshot and attach the infra cost sheet to the meeting notes.

-Marcus
Sr. Infrastructure Manager
Redwood Inference
